Verify Now Blog > KPCA Show 2026: Meet PCBWay at Booth R310 in South Korea KPCA Show 2026: Meet PCBWay at Booth R310 in South Korea by: Mila Aug 12,2026 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News PCBWay is excited to announce its participation in KPCA Show 2026, one of the key exhibitions for the global PCB, semiconductor substrate, and advanced packaging industries. The event will take place from September 9 to 11, 2026, at Songdo Convensia in Incheon, South Korea. During the exhibition, PCBWay will be at Booth R310, where visitors can meet our team, learn more about our PCB and electronics manufacturing capabilities, and discuss solutions for their upcoming projects. About KPCA Show 2026 KPCA Show 2026, officially known as the International Semiconductor Circuits and Advanced Packaging Show, will be held at Songdo Convensia in Incheon from September 9 to 11, 2026. The exhibition is organized by the Korea Semiconductor Packaging and Circuits Association (KPCA) and Incheon Metropolitan City. The show brings together companies and professionals from across the electronics manufacturing industry, with exhibition areas covering advanced semiconductor substrates, semiconductor packaging, plating and surface treatment, reliability equipment, automotive electronics, and motion control and collaborative robotics. As PCB technology continues to evolve toward higher density, greater reliability, and increasingly complex applications, KPCA Show provides an opportunity for industry professionals to explore new technologies and connect with manufacturing partners. Meet PCBWay at Booth R310 At Booth R310, the PCBWay team will be available to introduce our manufacturing capabilities and discuss how we can support projects from prototype development to production. PCBWay provides a range of electronics manufacturing services, including: PCB fabrication PCB assembly HDI and rigid-flex PCB Flexible PCB Advanced PCB manufacturing CNC machining 3D printing Sheet metal fabrication Injection molding Box build assembly Whether you are developing a new electronic product, preparing prototypes, or looking for a manufacturing partner for larger-scale production, our team can discuss your project requirements and help identify suitable manufacturing solutions. Visit PCBWay at KPCA Show 2026 If you are attending KPCA Show 2026, we invite you to stop by and meet the PCBWay team. Event: KPCA Show 2026 Date: September 9–11, 2026 Venue: Songdo Convensia, Incheon, South Korea Booth: R310 Website: Official KPCA Show 2026 Website Visitors can also take advantage of the show's free pre-registration before attending: Free Visitor Pre-Registration We look forward to meeting engineers, designers, manufacturers, and industry professionals at KPCA Show 2026 in Incheon. See you at Booth R310! Enter the year of your birth and check your Chinese Zodiac. Join us Wanna be a dedicated PCBWay writer? We definately look forward to having you with us.
